acceptance_predicates.description: A clean checkout can extract the complete model, storage, and command graph through one documented command and produce DOT plus SVG artifacts.
Graph nodes and edges are mechanically cross-checked against the authoritative registries and CLI command tree, with no unexplained settings or commands.
ASB and asb-tui documentation can consume the same generated graph and link user-facing names to internal relations without exposing secrets.

definition_of_done: The extraction series is qualified end to end and its artifacts are reproducible in CI and for developers.

inputs.description: AR-1844 through AR-1847 generated registries and fixtures.

outputs.description: Reproducible graph extraction receipt and developer usage documentation.

gates.description: Fresh checkout extraction, graph validation, SVG rendering, and privacy checks pass with deterministic counts and hashes.
